queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| where source matches "{{source}}" AND type matches "{{type}}"
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count by source,type
| transpose row source column type

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}   "Device compromised"
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data.email", "data.events[*]", "createTime" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, email, events, create_time
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{source}}" = "*", true, source matches "{{source}}")
|count by alert_id, create_time, customer_id, source, type, email, events
| where type = "Device compromised"
| parse regex field=events "(?<device_info>\{[^\{]+\})" multi
| json field=device_info "deviceType", "deviceId", "deviceCompromisedState" as device_type, device_id, compromised_state
| parse field=compromised_state "\u2018*\u2019" as compromised_state
| count by device_id, device_type, compromised_state, email, customer_id
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  AccountWarning suspicious
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| json field=data "email","loginDetails.ipAddress" as email, src_ip
| where type matches "Suspicious*"
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{source}}" = "*", true, source matches "{{source}}")
|count by src_ip
| sort by _count
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  AccountWarning suspicious
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| json field=data "email" as email
| where type matches "Suspicious*"
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{source}}" = "*", true, source matches "{{source}}")
|count by email
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| where source matches "{{source}}" and type matches "{{type}}"
| timeslice 1h
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count(alert_id) as todays_alerts by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift 1d as vs_yesterday| (todays_alerts - todays_alerts_vs_yesterday) as delta
| outlier delta threshold = 2, window = 5, consecutive=2

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| timeslice 1h
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)
| where source matches "{{source}}" AND type matches "{{type}}"
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count by type,_timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column type

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data", "securityInvestigationToolLink" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data, investigation_url nodrop
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count by alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data, investigation_url, _messageTime
| where source matches "{{source}}" and type matches "{{type}}"
| if(isNull(investigation_url), "https://admin.google.com/ac/ic/investigate", concat("https://",investigation_url)) as investigation_url
| toURL(concat("https://admin.google.com/ac/ac/alert/details?alertId=", alert_id), alert_id) as alert_id
| sort by _messageTime
| formatDate(_messageTime,"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as create_time
| fields create_time, customer_id, alert_id, source, type, investigation_url, data
| fields -_messageTime

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  "Leaked password"
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data", "data.email", "createTime" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data, email, breach_time
| where type="Leaked password"
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{source}}" = "*", true, source matches "{{source}}")
|count by breach_time, email, source, type
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| where source matches "{{source}}" and type matches "{{type}}"
| where type in ("Google Operations","Customer takeout initiated")
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count by alert_id
| count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| where source matches "{{source}}" and type matches "{{type}}"
| where type in ("Government attack warning","Device compromised","Leaked password")
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count by alert_id
| count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
| where source matches "{{source}}" and type matches "{{type}}"
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}")
|count by alert_id
| count

_sourceCategory={{GoogleWorkspaceAlertsDataSource}}  
| json "alertId","customerId","source","type","data" as alert_id, customer_id, source, type, data
|where if ("{{alert_id}}" = "*", true, alert_id matches "{{alert_id}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{source}}" = "*", true, source matches "{{source}}")
|count by source
| sort by _count
